_about: Retrieval QA (HotpotQA, BM25 over the HotpotQA corpus), thinking off, 1/10 for ours. Accuracy in %. tokens = mean reader (9B) input tokens per question (tok_counts.py: text = rq_text_eval's prompt; ours = rq_eval's student turn with each part as ceil(0.1 x side tokens) rows). Keys of text/ours/stage2 = passages K (ours: K/20 question-first calls of 20). null = not measured yet. none = the 9B with no passages (thinking off; dev200 1 pass, eval500 mean of 3 passes). eval500 ours: top-100 and top-200 are means of 3 passes (Oct 21 ≈21:05Z); top-20 and top-400 are 1 pass.

dev200.label: dev200: 200 validation questions, BM25 top K, 1 pass

eval500.label: eval500: 500 validation questions, BM25 top K, mean of 3 passes (ours top-100/200 and Text; ours top-20/400 1 pass)
